sources.mechanism: Global idHash permanently owns the input string as a property key; there is no deletion path.
Constructor interns JSON of processed vertex/fragment including program name. Constructor creates private object; .from has separate shared-object cache and is deliberately unused.
Compiled _programDataHash is per shader-system/renderer, keyed by source key. destroy/contextChange release compiled data. Source-key reuse does not merge cache maps of different renderers.

fix: Per-family private-name leases choose smallest unused slot; fresh GlProgram per owner; release after owned shader/program destruction or construction-failure cleanup; distinct live source keys and bounded interned names at peak concurrent ownership. Existing keys from an old pre-fix page remain until reload; fix prevents further monotonic growth in fresh runtime.
limits: Two post-GC snapshots do not establish retained sizes, allocation timestamps, or whole-heap leak absence. Native buffer replacement and JIT code growth are separately reported; this identified dictionary is a reproducible source-backed accumulation.
